_readme: Business-approved facts. The assistant may ONLY answer from this file. Any value starting with 'TODO' has not been confirmed yet. Items in 'verify_with_owner' were supplied but must be confirmed by the owner before going live.

opening_hours.note: Open seven days a week. Closing times are after midnight, i.e. the following morning.

ordering.methods: Online (Fireaway website and mobile app), by phone on 0161 526 4777, in person at the shop, or via Uber Eats, Deliveroo and Just Eat.
ordering.delivery_available: Delivery, including no-contact delivery, is available during all opening hours.
ordering.delivery_area: Ashton-under-Lyne (OL6) and nearby Tameside postcodes. Enter your postcode on the Fireaway Ashton-under-Lyne store page to check.
ordering.delivery_charge: Varies by postcode distance; shown at checkout.
ordering.minimum_order: Varies by postcode distance; shown at checkout.
ordering.delivery_time: Usually 30 to 45 minutes, longer at busy evening times.

bookings.how_to_book: Table bookings are not taken. Walk-in diners are welcome, first come first served, with limited casual seating.

menu_highlights: Cheesy Pizza (12 inch large): tomato base, mozzarella, parmesan and cheddar - £13.99
Amalfi Pizza (12 inch large): tomato base, mozzarella, black olives, parmesan and fresh basil - £14.99
Veggie Supreme Pizza (12 inch large): tomato base, mozzarella, onions, peppers, sweetcorn, mushrooms and black olives - £14.99
Vegan Supreme Pizza (12 inch large): tomato base, vegan cheese, peppers, red onions, mushrooms, sweetcorn and black olives - £15.99
deals: Collection special: any Classic Pizza for £7.99, collection orders only
Meal Deal 1 - £19.99: one 12 inch large pizza, one classic side and one 330ml soft drink
Double Deal - £25.99: any two 12 inch large pizzas
Meal Deal 2 - £31.99: two 12 inch large pizzas, one classic side and one 1.25L soft drink
Date Night - £34.99: two 12 inch large pizzas, one classic side, one dessert and one 1.25L soft drink
Full House Bundle - £47.99: three 12 inch large pizzas, two classic sides and one 1.25L soft drink

dietary.vegetarian: Vegetarian items are labelled on the menu, for example the Cheesy, Amalfi and Veggie Supreme pizzas.
dietary.vegan: There is a vegan range using vegan cheese, for example the Vegan Supreme.
dietary.gluten_free: TODO: owner to confirm gluten-free availability and wording. Do not state to customers until confirmed.

payments: Debit and credit cards, contactless, Apple Pay and Google Pay in store and online. Cash accepted for in-person counter orders and cash on delivery orders placed directly with the shop.
social: Fireaway Ashton-under-Lyne Instagram and Facebook page

faqs.question: Do you take table bookings?
faqs.answer: No, we do not take table bookings. Walk-in diners are welcome, first come first served.
